worth_considering.title: Preparation derivation requires a frozen upstream driver outside the packet
worth_considering.observation: Both initial and corrected preparation helpers read work/engineering/phase-e04/testerarmy-control.mjs and require SHA256 bfd38ca3ce933c5a72fdc0dfc7d7aedde8b3ab71f637701c80fe7563d6373100. That upstream driver is absent from this ZIP, so complete preparation/derivation replay requires retrieving that exact original.
worth_considering.impact: The complete byte-preserved derived cleanup_testerarmy_control.mjs is included and directly reproduces the actual working/broken fixture controls after restoring the documented repo/tools/output paths. This is not a blocker to that bounded direct-control reproduction claim. The preparation helpers are contextual history and are not self-contained extraction-and-run tools.
worth_considering.recommendation: For complete derivation replay, include the exact frozen upstream driver in a subsequent explicitly reviewed packet, or explicitly label the preparation helpers as historical/contextual with an external original prerequisite.

Only authorized publication/evidence paths and scoped original mappings read; private untracked REA expansion and unrelated projects were not read.

Published scripts preserve exact syntax and operational controls; they still require their documented original workspace layout, exact source/tool/browser dependencies and contextual historical prerequisites. Syntax checks do not establish runtime success.
